title: When crypto trading pauses
subtitle: A trading interruption can travel through the ETP wrapper.
summary: A crypto exchange outage and an exchange-traded product are connected through arbitrage and execution. Investigate that connection before interpreting a share-price gap as a change in the underlying asset. This is an illustrative mechanism, not a claim about a particular outage or a forecast.

edges.label: A route becomes unavailable
edges.explanation: SEC staff identifies closed or unavailable crypto trading platforms as a potential disruption to ETP arbitrage. Check which venues and settlement routes a product actually relies on.
edges.caveat: Other venues may remain accessible. One outage does not establish that creations or redemptions have stopped.

edges.label: Investigate a gap in pricing
edges.explanation: A spot crypto ETP share can trade above or below the value of its holdings. Impaired arbitrage is a possible explanation to investigate alongside investor demand and product-specific conditions.
edges.caveat: A gap is not guaranteed. Verify the timestamp, trading hours and valuation method before comparing prices.

edges.label: The traded price matters
edges.explanation: Investors buying ETP shares transact at the available market price. A premium or discount therefore matters to execution even when the underlying crypto price has not changed.
edges.caveat: This is not a return forecast. Spreads, fees, order type and the eventual selling price also affect the result.
